description: This file contains unit tests for verifying distributed activity propagation within an Orleans-based distributed system. The tests focus on ensuring proper context transfer via the Activity API, covering scenarios both with and without parent activities, and validating different activity ID formats (W3C and Hierarchical).

classes.name: ActivityPropagationTests
classes.description: Contains tests verifying activity and trace context propagation across Orleans grain calls, including configuration setup and activity ID format handling.

classes.name: ActivityPropagationTests.Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture that configures and initializes an Orleans cluster with support for distributed tracing and activity propagation.

methods.name: static ActivityPropagationTests()
methods.description: Constructor initializing an ActivityListener to monitor activities related to Orleans grain calls.

methods.name: Configure(ISiloBuilder hostBuilder)
methods.description: Configures silo builder to enable activity propagation and in-memory grain storage.

methods.name: Configure(IConfiguration configuration, IClientBuilder clientBuilder)
methods.description: Configures client builder to enable activity propagation.

methods.name: public ActivityPropagationTests(Fixture fixture)
methods.description: Constructor setting up activity ID format and state, and registering activity listener.

methods.name: WithoutParentActivity(ActivityIdFormat idFormat)
methods.description: Test verifying new activity creation when no parent activity exists, for both W3C and Hierarchical formats.

methods.name: WithParentActivity_W3C()
methods.description: Test verifying activity propagation with W3C format when a parent activity exists, including trace ID, trace state, and baggage verification.

methods.name: WithParentActivity_Hierarchical()
methods.description: Test verifying activity propagation with Hierarchical format when a parent activity exists, focusing on activity ID hierarchy and baggage.
